questions.q: In a CRM, what is a lead?
options: A potential customer who is not yet qualified
A customer with a signed contract
A support complaint from a customer
A product listed in the catalogue

questions.q: Which standard Salesforce object holds the companies you do business with?
options: Contact
Account
Opportunity
Campaign

questions.q: Converting a qualified lead usually creates which records?
options: Only a new case linked to the queue
A new user licence for the customer
An account, a contact and optionally an opportunity
A price book entry for the product

questions.q: When is a master-detail relationship a better choice than a lookup?
options: When the link between the records is optional
When each child record needs its own separate owner
When you are linking a record to a user
When child records can't exist alone and you need roll-up totals

questions.q: You need a field showing "days since last contact" that stays current without anyone editing it. What fits?
options: A formula field based on TODAY()
A text field that reps update weekly
A picklist with ranges of days
A number field filled by data import

questions.q: Sales wants to log dealer visits (date, outcome, notes) several times a month for each account. What do you build?
options: Ten extra text fields on Account
A custom object related to Account
A shared Excel sheet on the drive
A new record type on Contact

questions.q: Why be careful before changing a picklist field to a text field?
options: Text fields can't be placed on page layouts
Picklist fields can't be deleted afterwards
Reports, filters and automation using its values may break
All existing records on the object get deleted

questions.q: Users want a "State" field on accounts; some want a picklist, others free text. What is best for reporting?
options: Free text, so users can type any spelling they like
A long text area holding the full postal address
A separate checkbox field for each Indian state
A picklist of states, ideally dependent on country

questions.q: A client company has branches in three states, each with its own GSTIN. How should you model it?
options: A parent account with a child account per GST registration
One account with all GSTINs typed in a comma list
Three separate accounts with no link between them
GSTIN stored only on the contact records

questions.q: What is a profile mainly used for?
options: Storing the user's photo, bio and contact details
Setting what a user can do: object, field and app permissions
Deciding the user's monthly sales target
Choosing only the user's display language

questions.q: What do org-wide defaults set?
options: The company's logo and theme colours
The default currency used in reports
The baseline record access for each object
The login hours allowed for admins

questions.q: Why should each user have their own login instead of sharing one?
options: Shared logins make the system run slower for everyone
Separate logins reduce the total licence cost
Shared logins can't be used on the mobile app
For security and a correct audit trail of who did what

questions.q: What is a permission set best used for?
options: Giving extra access to some users without changing their profile
Taking away access that the user's profile already grants
Sharing one particular record with a single colleague
Changing the time zone for the whole organisation

questions.q: Regional managers must see their team's records but not other regions'. Org-wide default is Private. What helps?
options: Changing the default to Public Read/Write
A role hierarchy organised by region
Giving everyone the View All Data permission
Sharing each record manually by hand

questions.q: To hide a sensitive field such as PAN number from most users, what do you use?
options: Removing it from the page layout only
A validation rule on the field
Field-level security
A filter on the list view

questions.q: An employee leaving tomorrow owns 2,000 open accounts. What should the admin do?
options: Delete the user today so the licence becomes free
Keep the user active for a month in case of questions
Share the user's password with their manager for handover
Freeze the user, transfer records to the right owners, then deactivate

questions.q: A user can see an account but gets "insufficient privileges" on its opportunity. Likely cause?
options: Opportunity sharing is stricter than account access for them
The user's browser cache is full and needs clearing
The account record is missing its phone number
The user's password is about to expire this week

questions.q: What should an admin do with sensitive customer data like ID numbers under India's data protection rules?
options: Keep it in a field everyone can see, for convenience
Collect only what's needed, restrict access, and log who views it
Export it weekly to personal drives as a backup copy
Share it with partner firms so they can run marketing

questions.q: What does a validation rule do?
options: Sends an email every time a record is saved
Creates a report automatically each morning
Stops a record saving when data breaks a condition
Imports rows from an Excel sheet

questions.q: Which is Salesforce's main recommended point-and-click automation tool today?
options: Workflow rules
Process Builder
Apex triggers
Flow

questions.q: When is an approval process used?
options: When a record needs sign-off, like a discount above 15%
When a user resets their own password
When a report is scheduled to run daily
When a field is added to a page layout

questions.q: When should a record-triggered flow run before the record is saved?
options: To send emails to the customer
To update fields on that same record quickly
To create related child records
To call an external system's API

questions.q: Reps often skip the "Lost reason" when marking a deal lost. Best fix?
options: A reminder email to all reps every Friday evening
Make the field required at every single stage
A validation rule requiring it when stage is Closed Lost
Remove the field since no one fills it anyway

questions.q: A flow emails the customer when a case closes. 500 cases are about to be closed by a data load. Risk?
options: The data load will finish much faster than usual
The closed cases will reopen by themselves
All case reports will stop working afterwards
Hitting limits and flooding customers with emails

questions.q: Two flows and an Apex trigger all update Opportunity on save, and values flip unpredictably. What do you do?
options: Map all automation on the object and consolidate it with a clear order
Add a third flow that corrects the values after the others run
Delete the trigger straight away without checking its purpose
Ask users to save each opportunity twice to settle the values

questions.q: Why build and test a new flow in a sandbox before production?
options: Production orgs don't allow flows to be created at all
To catch errors and side effects without harming live data
Flows run noticeably faster inside a sandbox org
A sandbox test is required to activate the licence

questions.q: A flow fails for some users but works for others. What do you check first?
options: The file size of the org's logo and branding
The browser language each user has selected
The running user's access to the records and fields used
The number of dashboards each user has built

questions.q: Why set up duplicate rules for leads?
options: To copy each lead into two campaigns at once
To speed up the lead conversion process
To make lead records read-only for reps
To warn or block when the same person is entered twice

questions.q: Before a large data import, what should you always do?
options: Back up or export the current data
Delete all existing records first
Turn off user logins for a week
Reset every user's password

questions.q: What is an external ID field useful for?
options: Showing a record to people outside the company
Matching records to IDs from another system during imports
Encrypting the value stored in the field
Linking the record to a company website

questions.q: Phone numbers arrive as "98480 12345", "+91-9848012345" and "09848012345". What do you do before import?
options: Import them as they are; users will understand them
Keep the rows in the first format and drop the others
Standardise them to one format, such as +91 and ten digits
Move all of them into the description field instead

questions.q: What does an upsert do in a data load?
options: Uploads only attachments and files
Deletes all records and reloads them
Updates only the record owner field
Updates matching records and inserts the new ones

questions.q: Sales says 30% of contacts have no email address. What is a sensible plan?
options: Find the entry points, require email where it applies, and enrich old records
Delete every contact that does not have an email address
Fill the empty ones with dummy emails so reports look complete
Ignore it, since most of those contacts have a phone number

questions.q: When merging duplicate accounts, what must you decide carefully?
options: Which colour the merged account will show on the layout
Which record is the master and which values and related records to keep
Whether Salesforce support must be told before merging
Which of the two record owners logged in most recently

questions.q: An import set the wrong owners on 8,000 leads yesterday. What is the safest recovery?
options: Ask each sales rep to find and correct their own leads by hand this week
Delete all 8,000 leads and import the original file again from scratch
Use the pre-import backup to fix owners by update load, testing a small batch first
Restore the whole org from last week's full backup copy

questions.q: Why load data in a sensible order, such as accounts before contacts and opportunities?
options: Salesforce imports faster in alphabetical order
Contacts can't be imported after the first week
Opportunities are deleted if loaded first
Child records need their parent's ID to link correctly

questions.q: Which report format groups data by both rows and columns, like sales by rep and month?
options: Matrix
Tabular
Summary
Joined

questions.q: Where does a dashboard component get its data?
options: From a page layout
From a source report
From a validation rule
From a permission set

questions.q: Why schedule a report?
options: To lock it so that nobody can edit it
To delete old data from the system
To email it to people automatically at set times
To make the report load faster

questions.q: Which report shows accounts that have no opportunities at all?
options: An opportunities report filtered to an amount of zero
An accounts report sorted by created date
A dashboard gauge on the count of opportunities
An accounts report with a cross filter for "without opportunities"

questions.q: A dashboard runs as the admin, so every viewer sees all data. Why can this be a problem?
options: Viewers may see numbers they shouldn't; consider dynamic dashboards
Admins lose the ability to edit that dashboard later
It slows down the login page for every user
Its charts can no longer refresh automatically

questions.q: The sales head says the pipeline total doesn't match finance's figure. What do you check first?
options: Whether the report chart is shown as a bar chart or a pie chart
Filters, date fields, currency and which stages each report counts
The name of the folder where each report is saved
The font size and colours used on the sales dashboard

questions.q: How would you show lead-to-opportunity conversion rate by lead source?
options: Counting the leads by hand in Excel every week
A plain tabular report listing all leads
A summary report grouped by source with a custom summary formula
A single dashboard metric showing total leads

questions.q: Leadership wants to see how the pipeline changed week by week, but reports show only today's data. What do you suggest?
options: Ask every sales rep to email their weekly numbers to the manager
Take screenshots of the pipeline dashboard each Monday morning
Add a text field called "last week amount" on each opportunity
Reporting snapshots or historical trending to capture data over time

questions.q: A dashboard with 20 components loads slowly and half of it is never read. Best fix?
options: Agree the key decisions with users, keep essential charts, split by audience
Add more filters to every chart so users can find what they need
Set it to refresh every minute so the data is always current
Move the dashboard to a different folder with fewer viewers

task.title: Reply to the sales head's CRM change requests with a configuration plan
task.brief: You are the Salesforce admin. Read the sales head's email (below). In about 20 minutes, write a reply that she and your IT manager can follow. For each request say: how you would set it up in Salesforce (which feature and roughly how), anything you need to confirm with her first, and how you will test it before it goes live. If a request is risky or goes against good practice, say so politely and offer a safer option. A good answer uses the right features, protects data and users, mentions sandbox testing and rollout, and is clear and friendly.
task.material:
From: Kavita Rao, Head of Sales (West & South)
To: CRM Admin
Subject: Need these by next Monday

Hi,
1. Any discount above 10% on an opportunity must be approved by the regional manager. Above 20% needs me.
2. Reps should not be able to mark a deal 'Closed Won' without a PO number and the customer's GSTIN.
3. I want one dashboard showing pipeline by region and by rep, for this quarter, in ₹ lakhs.
4. Our 6 new interns start Monday. Please give them access to all accounts in the system so they can learn fast. Easiest is to give them the same login as Sameer.
5. Every time a deal above ₹10 lakh is won, send a WhatsApp/email alert to me and the regional manager.
6. Our old Excel list of 3,000 dealers needs to come into Salesforce. Many are already in the CRM.
Thanks,
Kavita
key_points: Discount approvals: an approval process (or flow) with two levels, 10% to regional manager and 20% to the sales head
Closed Won rule: a validation rule requiring PO number and GSTIN, with thought for customers who have no GSTIN
Dashboard from a summary/matrix report filtered to this quarter, grouped by region and rep; dynamic dashboard or right running user
Pushes back on shared login and all-accounts access for interns; offers own users, limited profile/permission set and role
Alert via record-triggered flow on Closed Won above ₹10 lakh; WhatsApp needs an approved integration
Dealer import: back up, clean and de-duplicate against existing accounts, use an external ID or matching and upsert
Builds and tests in a sandbox first and confirms details (e.g. GSTIN exceptions, who the regional managers are)
Realistic timeline: says what can be ready by Monday and what needs more time

rubric.label: Right features
rubric.guide: 0 = wrong or no features named, 3 = mostly right with gaps, 5 = the right feature for each request with sensible detail

rubric.label: Data and access safety
rubric.guide: 0 = agrees to the shared login and full access, 3 = notes a concern but weak fix, 5 = clearly refuses unsafe access and gives a safe, practical alternative

rubric.label: Completeness
rubric.guide: 0 = covers one or two items, 3 = covers most items, 5 = covers all six with testing, open questions and timing

rubric.label: Tone and clarity
rubric.guide: 0 = rude or confusing, 3 = clear but blunt or wordy, 5 = polite, structured and easy for a busy sales head to follow
